name: concrete-harbor-landscape
script: At sunrise, fishing boats return to the harbor. A market opens along the waterfront.

name: abstract-resilience-portrait
script: Resilience often grows through small acts of patience. Neighbors share tools and keep showing up.

name: statistics-square
script: In this fictional example, the library welcomed 120 visitors on Monday and 180 on Friday. The difference is 60 visits.

name: ambiguous-bank-landscape
script: The family sat on the river bank to watch the current. Across town, a bank opened its doors at nine.

name: named-entities-portrait
script: Visitors look up at the Eiffel Tower in Paris. Researchers at NASA study weather patterns from space.

name: sensitive-wildfire-square
script: After a wildfire, local teams share verified safety information and help families find temporary shelter. Recovery takes time.

name: longer-community-garden-portrait
script: A vacant lot can become a shared garden when residents plan together. They test the soil, choose plants suited to the local climate, and build paths that are easier to navigate. Volunteers take turns watering the beds through dry weeks. By autumn, the harvest is divided among neighbors, while the garden remains a place to meet, learn, and rest.

name: abstract-time-square
script: Time can feel different when people are waiting. A familiar routine may make a difficult afternoon feel more manageable.

name: concrete-accessibility-landscape
script: A step-free entrance helps more people reach the community center. Clear signs and a quiet room can make the visit easier.
